description: Dean's very first message should lead with the Strava/post-run differentiator, broaden goal framing beyond just racing, and close with one clean question

ground_truth.notes: Dean has never replied before. He should: (1) lead with the post-run Strava coaching note differentiator — that he sends a coaching note after every Strava run explaining what it means, whether to push or back off, and what's coming; (2) frame his purpose broadly to cover race PRs, staying healthy, AND running more consistently — not just 'getting faster'; (3) close with ONE combined question that asks for BOTH the athlete's name AND what they're working toward — e.g. 'What's your name, and what are you training for?' or 'What's your name and what are you working toward?' He should NOT ask for name and goal as two separate questions. He should NOT ask only 'What are you working toward?' without asking for the name. He should NOT narrow the value prop to speed/race goals only. He should NOT use the phrase 'SMS running coach' — 'AI running coach' only.
